facts.fact: Capacity Media reports that CSquared landed the Equiano cable in Togo in 2022 and provisioned services in 2023, with 3 Tbps on the cable.

CSquared's CEO says it increased capacity at the Lome Equiano landing station for Togocom, GVA and other Togo customers and provided capacity to MTN Ghana and Vodafone Ghana, and describes the firm as open-access.

systems.platform: submarine cable landing station at Lome
systems.owner: Google; landing station run by CSquared
